SQL for the species x hex x count table at one resolution

Source: R/species.R
obis_h3_species_sql.Rd

One row per (cell, aphiaid) from the store's occ_h3, with n the number of records and year_min, year_max the first and last year recorded (the Cell pane's first and last year; NULL when no record has a year). A resolution that is an occ_h3 tier (3, 5, 7) reads that tier; any other is rolled up from the next finer tier with h3_cell_to_parent() (res 4 from the res-5 tier, as in the decade layers). Rows with a NULL aphiaid are left out (no taxon filter can reach them).

Usage

obis_h3_species_sql(
  res,
  from = "occ_h3",
  lookup = NULL,
  decade = FALSE,
  decades = NULL
)

Arguments

res

H3 resolution, 1 to 7.

from

the species-level table (default "occ_h3").

lookup

optional name of the lookup table to join (see above).

decade

per decade (decade = floor(date_year / 10) * 10, records with a year only) instead of over all years (default FALSE).

decades

with decade = TRUE, the decades to keep (default NULL: all).

Value

a SQL string (a SELECT).

Details

With lookup, the name of a table holding obis_h3_species_lookup_sql()'s rows, the result has the columns of a species file plus the partition key: h3 VARCHAR, cell_id BIGINT, name_key INTEGER, aphiaid BIGINT, n BIGINT, year_min SMALLINT, year_max SMALLINT, class VARCHAR (the lookup's class, so one aphiaid always lands in one partition). Without it, cell_id, aphiaid, n, year_min, year_max. Per decade, the years are those within the decade.

Examples

cat(obis_h3_species_sql(4))
#> SELECT CAST(h3_cell_to_parent(cell_id, 4) AS BIGINT) AS cell_id, aphiaid::BIGINT AS aphiaid, SUM(records)::BIGINT AS n,
#>        MIN(date_year)::SMALLINT AS year_min, MAX(date_year)::SMALLINT AS year_max
#> FROM occ_h3
#> WHERE res = 5 AND aphiaid IS NOT NULL
#> GROUP BY ALL
